title: Why Nobody Ever Tried to Save Truman 🤯 #shorts
topic: The Truman Show — Everyone Knows Truman Is Being Watched. So Why Doesn't Anyone Tell Him?
description:
Millions of people know Truman Burbank is living inside a manufactured television set. They watch his heartbreaks, his private grief, and his deepest fears. They feel genuine affection for him. So why does almost nobody try to help him escape?

Discover the chilling psychological contradiction at the heart of The Truman Show (1998): their entertainment requires his imprisonment. The audience weeps for Truman's pain while silently demanding that the cameras keep rolling.
